title.zh: 将泰亚巴斯省 Pitogo 市镇的 Tohian 和 Macpac 两个村区并入同省 Catanauan 市镇的法案
title.en: AN ACT ANNEXING THE BARRIOS OF TOHIAN AND MACPAC, OF THE MUNICIPALITY OF PITOGO, TO THE MUNICIPALITY OF CATANAUAN, BOTH IN THE PROVINCE OF TAYABAS.
title.orig: AN ACT ANNEXING THE BARRIOS OF TOHIAN AND MACPAC, OF THE MUNICIPALITY OF PITOGO, TO THE MUNICIPALITY OF CATANAUAN, BOTH IN THE PROVINCE OF TAYABAS.
title.vi: Đạo luật sáp nhập các khu Tohian và Macpac thuộc đô thị Pitogo vào đô thị Catanauan, tỉnh Tayabas
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติผนวกหมู่บ้านTohianและMacpacของเทศบาลPitogoเข้าเป็นส่วนหนึ่งของเทศบาลCatanauanในจังหวัดTayabas
title.id: Undang-Undang yang menggabungkan barrio Tohian dan Macpac di Kotamadya Pitogo ke Kotamadya Catanauan, Provinsi Tayabas
title.ms: Akta yang menggabungkan barrio Tohian dan Macpac di Perbandaran Pitogo ke Perbandaran Catanauan, Wilayah Tayabas

source.name: The LawPhil Project — Arellano Law Foundation

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil PDF 文本化成果（第三方 OCR，非机翻），原始文件 ACT_01304_1905_html.txt

text.en:
The barrios of Tohian and Macpac, now a part of the municipality of Pitogo, Province of Tayabas,
are hereby annexed to and consolidated with the municipality of Catanauan, in the same province.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, February 24, 1905.
